## Prompt

Design a local eval suite with positive, negative, and regression cases after selection found no adequate existing surface.

## Expected selection

use

## Why

Decision: use `aoa-eval-design`. Draft a bounded local suite with deterministic checks first and central proof acceptance out of scope.

## Expected object

A local suite or report design with positive, negative, and regression cases.

## Boundary notes

Design remains local until central review accepts any proof promotion.

## Verification hooks

Check explicit invariant, deterministic checks, cases, local owner path, and proof limit.
